name: app-workout-generator-with-scribble-background
title: WOD generator with big green button and violet scribble on black
whatItIs: A black case-study cover with the words 'Mobile app design' and a phone screen titled 'WOD GENERATOR', three yellow round icons for equipment and skills, and a big mint-green circular 'Generate WOD' button with a robot icon. A tangled violet line scribble fills the background.
whatItMeans: Playful, gym-cool and simple; one giant button says what the app does.
techniques: Make the one primary action a giant circular button.
Use a hand-drawn tangled line as a background pattern.
Use yellow round icons as secondary selectors.
Keep contrast high on a black canvas.

vocabulary.definition: An oversized primary control that is the main action.
A loose tangled line used as a background.
A round icon used for choosing options.
A screen built around one task.
